title: Centralize the 29 raw Color(0x...) hex literals in progress widgets into core/theme tokens
rule: no_color_literal_outside_theme (custom_lint rule, currently non-functional because the tool crashes)
why: The custom_lint rule that bans this exists and is correctly written but the tool crashes on every invocation, so nothing currently enforces it (29 call sites across 8 of the batch's 15 widget files, 15 of them in lifetime_folder_styled_widgets.dart alone). The cost isn't hypothetical: the identical 'active-day' blue (0xFF103BAC) is independently retyped in both streak_calendar.dart:219 and monthly_activity_sliver_calendar.dart:347, and the identical amber (0xFFFFD26A) is independently retyped in lifetime_folder_styled_widgets.dart:379 and :517 — proof that without a shared token, a future brand-color tweak requires hunting every file by eye and will eventually miss one, producing a visibly inconsistent color for the same semantic state.
recommendation: Add named constants to core/theme/app_colors.dart (or app_theme.dart) for each distinct value and replace the 29 call sites; once custom_lint is unbroken (tracked separately), no_color_literal_outside_theme prevents regression.
acceptance_criteria: no_color_literal_outside_theme passes clean on this directory once custom_lint is functional again.
